abstract: Intratesticular masses can be identified with a high degree of accuracy using recently refined techniques of scrotal ultrasonography. In an attempt to correlate sonographic findings with histopathologic features the sonograms performed on 17 consecutive patients with testis tumors were reviewed. Two distinct categories were identified. Seminomas and lymphomas appeared hypoechoic and homogeneous, and had sharply demarcated intratesticular borders. Nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, although also of lower echogenicity than normal testis, appeared to have cystic spaces, acoustic shadowing and irregular margins extending into the testis parenchyma. Preoperative characterization of a scrotal mass with ultrasound can facilitate surgical excision of the tumor. Scrotal ultrasonography also is useful in the detection of tumor in a palpable normal testis and is a convenient method for the examination of patients who have had a testis tumor previously.
abstract_ja: 陰嚢超音波検査の最新技術を用いることで、精巣内腫瘤を高い精度で同定できる。組織病理所見と超音波所見を対応させるため、精巣腫瘍患者17例の連続した超音波像を再検討した。二つの明確な類型が同定された。セミノーマと悪性リンパ腫は低エコー・均一で、精巣内の境界が鋭く区切られていた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍も正常精巣より低エコーであったが、嚢胞状の空間、音響陰影、精巣実質へ連続する不整な辺縁を示した。超音波によって陰嚢内腫瘤を術前に特徴づけることは、腫瘍の外科的切除を容易にしうる。陰嚢超音波検査は、触知しない正常精巣内の腫瘍の検出にも有用であり、既往に精巣腫瘍のある患者の検査にも簡便な方法である。
